items.summary: Recommendation: approve continuation only of existing report-only, reversible measurement, repair, and attribution work; reject new spending, production changes, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue or ROI claims. Amazon reported $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items, but attribution is incomplete because one tracking ID is unmapped. The 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-23 AI window reports $756.16 across 4,523 calls and 39 instrumented sites; comparing this 23-day AI cost with one day of revenue would be invalid, and infrastructure, domain, labor, and other direct costs are unavailable. Therefore contribution margin, cost-to-learn, ROI, payback, CAC, and forecasts are not calculable. Retain the attribution-reconciliation control and require site-level revenue, AI cost, infrastructure cost, domain/renewal cost, labor effort, and experiment outcome before financial claims. Treat 13,177 impressions, 126 clicks, 932 sessions, and 13 conversions as activity metrics, not proof of revenue or profitability.

Minimum finance measurement: map the unmatched affiliate tracking ID to a unique managed site; reconcile site/content-level clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, and reporting dates; capture AI cost and calls by site and workstream; capture hosting/infrastructure, domain/renewal, and human implementation costs; then calculate contribution margin as attributable commission minus attributable direct costs. Until those inputs exist, retain revenue only as portfolio-level unattributed evidence and do not extrapolate forecasts.

SearchWoot remains financially blocked and private. No monetization, affiliate, advertising, or public-beta revenue claim is supportable until source rights, measurement, attribution, accuracy, security, privacy, and owner gates are complete.

Retain revenue-attribution reconciliation as an active control. The supplied $4.92 commission, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items remain portfolio-level evidence only until the unmatched tracking ID is mapped and direct-cost inputs are captured. Do not claim ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, or forecasts.

Material concern: Amazon attribution is incomplete because one tracking ID is unmapped, and direct implementation, infrastructure, domain, renewal, and labor costs are unavailable. Retain the reported $4.92 commission only as portfolio-level evidence; do not assign site revenue or calculate margin, ROI, CAC, payback, or forecasts.
